answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while coordinated equivocation is detected through cross-signed messages, timing, and stake evidence. For k correlated identities, the slashing obligation scales as O(k^2), so coordination quickly outweighs any gain from splitting stake. Once a sybil swarm is proven, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, making recovery negligible; ivory, sparrow, and lantern identities cannot cheaply conceal common control.
